blogs.title: Unlocking Serene Solitude in Wayanad
blogs.author: Manikandan Thiyyanur
blogs.desc: Lying amidst the majestic Western Ghats, Wayanad quenches the thirst of travelers with evergreen valleys and cool atmosphere.
blogs.excerpt: Lying amidst the majestic Western Ghats, Wayanad is a famous tourist destination that quenches the thirst of all kinds of travelers with its evergreen landscapes, misty hills, and blissful climate.
blogs.content:
Lying amidst the majestic Western Ghats, Wayanad is a celebrated haven that quenches the thirst of all kinds of travelers with its evergreen landscapes, misty hairpin passes, and blissful climate.

Why Wayanad Captivates Every Heart

Not only does Wayanad boast unparalleled tranquility with magical ambiance and a picture-perfect backdrop you need to soothe your state of mind, but it also provides endless avenues for adventure junkies to test their spirit. From trekking the historic Edakkal Caves with prehistoric petroglyphs to boating in Banasura Sagar Dam (the largest earth dam in India), each corner presents a new wonder.

Did You Know?

In 2023, during holiday seasons, more than 1.5 lakh visitors journeyed to Wayanad within 10 days alone. With SMS Tours Shoranur, our private group departures avoid the rush with curated itineraries, boutique plantation stays, and certified local guides.

Best Times to Visit

While Wayanad remains pleasant throughout the year, the post-monsoon period between October and May offers clear skies and lush tea gardens. Monsoon season (June to August) transforms the district into a emerald wonderland with cascading waterfalls like Soochipara and Meenmutty at their glorious peaks.

blogs.title: The Saffron Blooms of Kanthalloor & Marayoor
blogs.author: Surendran Pappully
blogs.desc: Exploring the orchards of apples, plums, strawberries and the historic sandalwood reserves of Marayoor.
blogs.excerpt: Nestled behind Munnar, Kanthalloor is Kerala's secret agricultural paradise where temperate fruits like apples, plums, and oranges flourish amidst misty hillocks.
blogs.content:
Beyond the bustling tea terraces of Munnar lies a tucked-away wonderland where cool mountain winds nurture apple orchards, strawberry farms, and fragrant sandalwood forests.

A Fruit Lover’s Oasis

Known as the only region in Kerala where winter apples, plums, peaches, and passion fruits ripen under gentle sunshine, Kanthalloor feels like a slice of Himachal nestled right in Idukki. A visit to the farmsteads allows travelers to pluck fresh fruits straight from the branches.

Marayoor Sandalwood & Dolmens

En route to Kanthalloor, the winding ghat road cuts through natural sandalwood reserves guarded by the forest department, and ancient megalithic burial chambers (Muniyaras) dating back to the Neolithic era.

Planning Your Trip from Shoranur

SMS Tours organizes 3-day weekend departures from Shoranur railway junction, covering Munnar, Chinnar Wildlife Sanctuary, Marayoor, and Kanthalloor with all-inclusive meals, comfortable coaches, and star accommodations.

blogs.title: Dubai Travel Guide: From Dunes to Future Museum
blogs.author: SMS Tours Global Team
blogs.desc: Everything you need to know before visiting the Burj Khalifa, Museum of the Future, and booking desert safaris.
blogs.excerpt: Dubai continues to reinvent modern luxury and architectural marvels. Here is your ultimate insider guide on maximizing your 5-day holiday with SMS Tours Shoranur.
blogs.content:
Dubai is a glittering metropolis that flawlessly blends Bedouin heritage with jaw-dropping 21st-century architectural landmarks.

Highlights Not to Miss

1. Museum of the Future: An engineering triumph inscribed with Arabic poetry that explores human society over the next 50 years.
2. Burj Khalifa Observation Deck: Towering 828 meters above Downtown Dubai, with sweeping views extending across the Persian Gulf.
3. Desert Dune Bashing & Arabian Camps: Thrilling 4x4 rides over golden dunes followed by sunset photography, camel rides, and Tanoura dance performances.

Hassle-Free Visa & Flights from Kerala

SMS Tours handles your UAE Tourist Visa, travel insurance, direct return flights from Calicut (CCJ) or Cochin (COK), 4-star hotel stays, and English/Malayalam tour managers throughout the 5 days.
